finding.observed: Current main still launches Claude with --allowedTools mcp__clayverse__* while the admitted baseline MCP exposes session_state and request_effect.
finding.risk: A later tool added to the same managed MCP server would inherit automatic approval without an explicit terminal-boundary admission change.
finding.counterhypothesis: Managed server allowlisting alone is sufficient.
finding.counterhypothesis_result: WEAKER_THAN_EXACT_TOOL_ADMISSION: server identity stays managed, but wildcard approval broadens automatically when the server grows.

primary_dependency_evidence.anthropic: Current Claude Code documentation supports exact MCP permission names; --allowedTools is the approval layer, and dontAsk denies unapproved tools rather than prompting.
